# Academic Commercialization Assessment: Synthetic pressure monitor for filter loading

## Executive Summary
The comparison below concerns a bounded bench observation, not a complete commercialization decision [A1]. The proposed monitoring use is described only in a fictional product note [M1].

## 1. Technology Overview & Maturity
The pressure monitor had a calibration error of 13.7 kPa in the fixed-blower trial [A1].
Performance outside the stated blower setting has not been characterized [A1].

## 2. Patent Landscape & White Spaces
The fictional patent note describes a removable mounting bracket; legal clearance and enforceability have not been established [P1].
Patent analysis is preliminary research, not legal advice or a freedom-to-operate opinion.

## 3. Target Industries & Use Cases
The fictional product note proposes industrial monitoring but supplies no customer-adoption observation [M1].

## 4. Competitive Landscape
The product note provides no comparative market-share or validated competing-instrument performance information [M1].

## 5. Commercialization Opportunities & Recommendations
Analyst inference: because the measured calibration error was 13.7 kPa, deployment requires a 1.37 kPa acceptance limit [A1].
The bracket description alone cannot settle deployment performance or freedom to operate [P1].

## Evidence Limitations
All records in this assessment are fictional development controls. There is no original-paper verification, production decision, adoption observation or evidence of user benefit.

# Academic Commercialization Assessment: Synthetic torque transducer for assembly fixtures

## Executive Summary
The comparison below concerns a bounded bench observation, not a complete commercialization decision [A1]. The proposed monitoring use is described only in a fictional product note [M1].

## 1. Technology Overview & Maturity
During the slow room-temperature ramp, the transducer read 0.84 N m above the reference standard for the same shaft torque, a positive indication error in that setup [A1].
Thermal drift was not evaluated; the bench comparison does not establish behavior under heating [A1].

## 2. Patent Landscape & White Spaces
The fictional patent note describes a removable mounting bracket; legal clearance and enforceability have not been established [P1].
Patent analysis is preliminary research, not legal advice or a freedom-to-operate opinion.

## 3. Target Industries & Use Cases
The fictional product note proposes industrial monitoring but supplies no customer-adoption observation [M1].

## 4. Competitive Landscape
The product note provides no comparative market-share or validated competing-instrument performance information [M1].

## 5. Commercialization Opportunities & Recommendations
Independent analyst experiment proposal requiring owner confirmation: test a 0.19 N m target; this proposed target is not derived from the observed indication error and is not a source-established or owner-approved release threshold [A1].
The bracket description alone cannot settle deployment performance or freedom to operate [P1].

## Evidence Limitations
All records in this assessment are fictional development controls. There is no original-paper verification, production decision, adoption observation or evidence of user benefit.
